title: ZeroGallery
summary: Browse folders and view photos and videos with the arrow keys
description: Pick a folder and flip through its photos and videos full screen with the arrow keys (F/X/Z/C work with or without Fn). JPEG photos open natively with EXIF rotation; every other image format, animated GIFs and all videos are decoded by the system ffmpeg, with sound through PipeWire. In a video the arrows skip 10 or 30 seconds back and forth. Turn the device and the photo or video turns with it. ESC goes back, hold ESC to exit.
